system.description: Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of a Bell Wire casts a jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component, you can spend your reaction to Dispel that Bell Wire. When you do, the triggering creature must make a Wisdom saving throw as they begin to hear music from all directions. On a failure, they become Confused for the next minute. A creature Confused in this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the Confused condition on a success.
